project.description: The project that the target should be added to.
project.x-prompt: Which project should a target be created for?

user.description: User information to use when authoring deployment commit

targetName.description: The name of the target to add.

preview.description: Configure the deploy target for PR preview deployments. The executor auto-detects pull request context at runtime, so the same `deploy` target publishes a normal release outside of PRs and a `pr/<N>` preview when running in a PR.

previewUrl.description: Base URL where previews will be hosted (used to build the PR comment link). Only applied when `preview` is true.

addCleanupTarget.description: Also add a `cleanup-previews` target that removes stale PR preview deployments.
